reason: The tetragonal cell is strongly supported, but the submitted element-specific realization is not. With Z=1 in a 231.89 A^3 cell it has an implausible density of 3.78 g/cm^3 and 115.95 A^3 per ABO3 unit; Z=2 would give the normal perovskite-scale 57.97 A^3 per ABO3 unit. Direct coordination confirms the packing failure: La and Mg have no oxygen within 3.0 A, while Sr and Ta are only four-coordinate. The reported 0.0257 residual is a bespoke profile/peak-height residual with no supplied comparable whole-pattern score, and the trace obtained the low residual only after switching from full Z=2 contents to the half-filled Z=1 model; it did not comparably refine chemically credible Z=2 symmetry/order alternatives. A materially different full-content Sr/La-Mg/Ta oxide framework is therefore scientifically likely and another attempt is warranted.
